styles.name: 16-Bit Pixel Art (SNES / Genesis)
styles.prompt: 16-bit pixel art style, crisp edges, limited palette, handcrafted pixels, nostalgic video game sprite, clean outline, solid white background, high contrast dithering
styles.negative: blurry, smooth gradients, photo, realistic, 3D render, anti-aliased noise, modern vector, busy background

styles.name: 32-Bit Pixel Art (GBA / PS1)
styles.prompt: 32-bit pixel art, vibrant color shading, detailed silhouette, clean sprite sheet aesthetic, solid white background, masterfully drawn game asset
styles.negative: low quality, jagged messy pixels, photographic, 3D mesh, blurry background

styles.name: Hand-Drawn 2D (Hollow Knight / Cuphead Style)
styles.prompt: crisp hand drawn 2D game asset, bold clean vector ink lines, cel shading, studio cartoon game art, isolated on pure white background, distinct silhouette
styles.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, noise, complex backdrop, pixelated, blurred edges

styles.name: Isometric Tactics RPG (Final Fantasy Tactics)
styles.prompt: isometric 2.5D game sprite, Final Fantasy Tactics art style, dimetric angle, painted texture, clean rim lighting, isolated on solid white backdrop
styles.negative: flat 2D, side scroller, overhead map, blurry, perspective distortion

styles.name: Stylized 3D Pre-Rendered Sprite (DKC Style)
styles.prompt: prerendered 3D game sprite, soft ambient occlusion, clay or plastic stylized material, clean studio lighting, isolated on white background
styles.negative: pixelated, low resolution, photo background, dirty artifacts
